items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Basie eventually asked me to sit in, I was scared to death, but I played a little.

ctx.x: Yeah, and the prospects for out of work musicians were bleak -- and we were in the streets of Kansas City. We were there on a Sunday, and I'm getting a little ahead of myself in telling about Basie. I knew little about what was happening there except a cab driver or somebody told me -- I had only a couple of dollars in my pocket -- told me it was Sunday and nothing was opened until Monday, they had the blue laws there -- why I don't know. But crime was rampant along with jazz.
Well, I was walking down the street on a Sunday night, and I met a girl who asked me what I was looking for and I said, 'music'.
